capitalization.description:
Interest capitalization type:
* `none` - Interest is paid out to linked_account, principal stays constant
* `simple` - Interest calculated on original principal only, may accrue (accrued_interest) but does not generate further interest
* `compound` - Interest added to principal at each period, next period's interest calculated on the new total
